xiphoid: (a) Like a sword; ensiform. (b) Of or pertaining to the xiphoid process; xiphoidian.
xiphiplastron: The posterior, or fourth, lateral plate in the plastron of turtles; -- called also xiphisternum.
xiphias: 1. (Zoöl.) A genus of fishes comprising the common swordfish. 2. (Anat.) (a) The constellation Dorado. (b) A comet shaped like a sword
xiphidium: A genus of plants of the order Hæmodraceæ, having two-ranked, sword-shaped leaves.
xiphius: A genus of cetaceans having a long, pointed, bony beak, usually two tusklike teeth in the lower jaw, but no teeth in the upper jaw.
xiphura: Same as Limuloidea. Called also Xiphosura. X ray. See under Ray.
xiphioid: Of, pertaining to, or resembling, a cetacean of the genus Xiphius or family Xiphiidæ.
xiphisternum: (a) The posterior segment, or extremity, of the sternum; -- sometimes called metasternum, ensiform cartilage, ensiform process, or xiphoid process. (b) The xiphiplastron. -- Xiph"i*ster"nal a.
xiphodon: An extinct genus of artiodactylous mammals found in the European Tertiary formations. It had slender legs, didactylous feet, and small canine teeth.
